title: Relative weakly associated and associated points agree for a locally finite type morphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for f : X -> S locally of finite type and a quasi-coherent F on X, WeakAss_{X/S}(F) = Ass_{X/S}(F) (source lines 1211-1216). The proof states the reduction: the fibres of f are locally Noetherian schemes, and on a locally Noetherian scheme associated and weakly associated points coincide, so the relative notions agree point by point on each fibre.
